body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> HD Radio presented ''SoundWorks Radio 820HD'' during CES 2007. It is designed to deliver clear sound quality as possible for HD radio. It features a telescoping antenna supporting FM band and an external AM loop antenna for AM band. It could be a nice complement in the bedroom, living room or office, the company claimed.
